Otherwise, execution will be forcibly terminated."<FC:B4:3E>
Yamato: "Huh? The elevator's moving. That's unusual.
Is someone in there?"
Touya: "Of course people use it."
Yamato: "But whenever I see it, it's always stopped.
Right on the floor I'm on, too."
Touya: "You're imagining it. Just imagining it. Anyway..."
Yamato: "Oh, it stopped."
Fain: "Hahahahahahaha!
To protect the ones I love, the blade of justice strikes the enemy!
My red blood burns crimson! That's how a man lives!
A man of justice and truth!
FAIN... JIN... BARION!!
At your service! For justice... I could die."
Yamato: "..."
Touya: "..."
Fain: "...Huh?"
Yamato: "..."
Touya: "..."
Fain: "Heeey!"
Fain: "H-Hey! Don't ignore me!
I went to all the trouble of waiting for you..."
Touya: "...You ought to have Gabon look at you sometime."
Fain: "What?! I'm the very picture of health!
I'm not so weak that I'd get sick!
Dahahahaha!"
Yamato: "...It's serious."
Fain: "...Well? What did you think? I'm pretty confident
about this one. Ah, my own talent frightens me."
It's pretty good.
Sounds like enka.
Fain: "Right? Especially the ending. Even saying it myself
sends shivers down my spine."
Yamato: "He's drunk on himself... It's terminal."
Touya: "I-I see. Well, keep at it."
Fain: "'Enka'? What's that?"
Yamato: "Hmm. You could call it 'the Japanese people's
song of the heart,' I suppose."
Fain: "The heart? So you mean a song that speaks straight to the soul,
is that it?"
Yamato: "W-Well, something like that."
Fain: "Oh! So my speech is just as
magnificent as that!"
Yamato: "Y-Yeah... Maybe..."
Fain: "Dahahahaha! You understand!"
Yamato: "By the way, Fain, why are you so
straightforward?"
Fain: "Hehehehe... Because I believe in justice!
To die for it would be my greatest wish!
And that justice is also to protect those dear to me!"
Touya: "Huh. Those dear to you, eh...?"
Fain: "Yes! For the princess, and for Ymir,
and f-for Kasumi... No! My justice is not
so fickle! Oh, what am I to do...?"
Yamato: "...What should we do?"
Touya: "We'd better keep our distance..."
Fain: "We're friends, aren't we?!
Tell me, who am I supposed to fight for?
I've sworn to love only one woman.
But I have the noble and supreme duty of protecting the princess.
I can abandon neither loyalty nor love.
Ah... What a trial! This is a knight's destiny!
Then I shall press on! To fight fate itself!
No, wait. Master said that wanting too much at once
is the same as losing it all.
Does that mean I must devote myself to one or the other?!
Oh! How can this be!
And to choose between Ymir and Kasumi...
Grr, it's all because of those ≪Ze=Ode≫ bastards...
If not for them, I'd never have had to endure
such suffering...
Ah! Could this be their conspiracy?!
Grrrrrr, damn them... How despicable...
No, how fearsome the ≪Ze=Ode≫ are!!
But I, Fain Jin Barion, will never let something so small
break me! Hm? In that case,
to turn their plans against them, my love for the two women
and my loyalty to the princess must all be protected
at the same time! Is that it?
No, but that would go against Master's teachings.
Aaaah, what am I supposed to doooo?!!"
Fain: "...Huh? Touya? Heeey..."
Yamato: "...He has his troubles too."
Touya: "Well, his life's pretty full in its own way, isn't it?
Anyway, let's go."
Yamato: "Y-Yeah..."
Kasumi: "Oh, Touya-chan..."
Ymir: "Perfect timing. I was going to show Kasumi to her room.
Could you do it for me?
I can't leave my post right now..."
Touya: "Her room?"
Ymir: "Yes, the room Kasumi will be staying in.
We've only done some basic decorating, but it's finished,
so she should be able to use it right away."
Touya: "Hmm. And where is it?"
Ymir: "In Section 1 of Level 3..."
Touya: "...Which is where?"
Yamato: "Oh, I know.
That's right across from your room, Touya, isn't it?"
Ymir: "Yes. I'll leave it to you, then."
Kasumi: "Thank you very much.
Touya-chan, Yamato, let's go."
Yamato: "Yeah! Off we go!"
Ymir: "Aren't you going?"
Touya: "Oh, yeah... See you."
Ymir: "Yes."
Yamato: "Here it is."
Kasumi: "Well, then..."
Touya: "Hm? Is something wrong?"
Kasumi: "Why aren't you coming in?"
Touya: "Huh? Is that okay?"
Kasumi: "Why wouldn't it be? Don't be shy. Come in."
Yamato: "Well, then..."
Touya: "Thanks for having us..."
Touya: "Hmm... It's pretty nice in here."
Kasumi: "Yeah. They're already helping me, and now they've even
got a room ready for me..."
Touya: "Well, when you think about it, getting a room each
is pretty good treatment. Meals included, too."
Kasumi: "Oh, Touya-chan..."
Yamato: "Hey, Kasumi, you didn't bring a change of clothes, did you?"
Kasumi: "No. But Bart said he'd get some ready for me."
Touya: "Come to think of it, Ai had him get her a camera
too, didn't she...?"
Yamato: "...Bart could make a living
doing that sort of thing, couldn't he?"
Touya: "Anyway, if that's taken care of, there aren't any
problems for now."
Kasumi: "Right. Oh, I know.
Could I come over to your room sometime, Touya-chan?"
Touya: "Huh? Sure, I don't mind..."
Kasumi: "It's in the section directly opposite this room,
isn't it?"
Yamato: "Ding ding! That's our Kasumi.
Your brain works better than Touya's."
Touya: "Sorry about that."
Kasumi: "Hehehe. I'll be looking forward to it."
Touya: "Yeah."
Yamato: "Touya, Kasumi probably wants to rest.
Let's get going."
Touya: "Hm? Good idea."
Kasumi: "Come visit again anytime."
Touya: "Yeah. See you."
